description: runner_up null (single-option decision) with NO fragile edges. Pins two branches nothing else reaches: the assembler's "runner_up: null (single-option decision)" line, and the scenario-contexts rule when there is no fragile-edge corpus to key on.

provenance.note: Revived; edge id added. Kept deliberately sparse — an empty fragile_edges array is the input state that makes the scenario-context dimension report "no corpus" instead of passing vacuously.

input.brief: Should we renew the data warehouse contract for another year?

candidates.label: good
candidates.note: One headline, no comparative framing, no scenario_contexts. Should PASS.

output.narrative_summary: Renew for One Year comes out ahead in about 77% of simulations. Query load growth is the input that could move platform cost against it.

story_headlines.opt_renew: Holds up in most runs, sensitive to query load growth

robustness_explanation.summary: The result holds in about 88% of runs.
robustness_explanation.primary_risk: Query load growth could push platform cost above the level assumed.
stability_factors: Query load growth is the only input shaping cost, and it is reasonably supported.

output.readiness_rationale: Nothing here is close, so the main thing to watch is query load growth.

fac_query_load.why: Query load growth is the only input shaping cost.
fac_query_load.expected_gain: Would firm up the cost path.

key_assumptions: Query load growth stays inside the range examined.
